title: The True Cost of Credit Card Minimum Payments
hook_text: A $3,000 BALANCE CAN OUTLAST YOUR CAR

beats.say: A $3,000 balance can outlast your car, your job, and your phone.
beats.visual: Extreme close up of a rusted car headlight in heavy rain at night, sodium streetlamp reflection.

beats.say: When you only pay the minimum on a 22% rate, where does your cash actually vanish?
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a massive concrete bridge pier at dusk, wet asphalt reflecting cold light.

beats.say: Most assume paying the minimum gets the principal down fast.
beats.visual: Silhouette of a lone person walking past a towering glass skyscraper, overcast sky.

beats.say: That's false. At 22%, the minimum payment is just 1% plus the monthly interest.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a solitary freight train crossing a foggy mountain ridge at dawn.

beats.say: So how long does it take to wipe out that $3,000?
beats.visual: Close up of heavy drops falling into a deep puddle, dark moody lighting.
View from under a high highway overpass looking out at empty grey concrete pillars in fog.

beats.say: That is 15 years of monthly payments.
beats.visual: Extreme close up of peeling black paint on an abandoned metal door under a single bulb.

beats.say: And what is the total cost of that timeline?
beats.visual: Low angle tilt up a towering brick warehouse wall against a pale blue hour sky.

beats.say: You will hand over $4,433 in interest alone.
beats.visual: Silhouette of a single hand holding a dark metal railing above a steep drop, cold wind.

beats.say: That is more than the original debt itself.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of an empty four lane highway stretching into heavy fog at night.

beats.say: Pay more than the minimum today. Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: Back view of a solitary figure walking toward a bright horizon at sunrise under a massive overpass.

caption: The math behind credit card minimum payments is brutal. $3,000 at 22% takes 15 years and costs $4,433 in interest. #creditcards #debtfree #personalfinance #moneytips #financialliteracy
description: Discover the hidden math of credit card minimum payments. Paying only the minimum on $3,000 at 22% stretches across 15 years and costs thousands in extra interest.
first_comment: What is the longest you've ever carried a credit card balance?

facts.claim: $3,000 credit card balance at 22% paying only the minimum takes 180 months and costs $4,433 in interest
